snippet.title: Return To Wonderland{Platinum & Deluxe Version} Walkthrough-World 1-Back in the Swing of Things
snippet.description:
Hello again my friends and welcome to the CLASSIC LEVEL SET OF RETURN TO WONDERLAND!

In this Classic Set,take Stinky and Loof on and adventure through ten worlds and eighty-five diverse levels of increasing difficulty.These levels in this set are more difficult than Deluxe level set,so be careful on how to solve them.

This Walkthrough has these levels:
A little refresher
Reflectors!
Upon further Reflection
Clear the Way
Rolling Stones
Boulder Blockade
Let's get Rolling
Relay Race

For more information about this game,enter in this site:
http://www.midnightsynergy.com/returntowonderland/

For game hints about this game,enter in this site:
http://www.midnightsynergy.com/returntowonderland/hints/
